title: Celestial Envoy
next_chapter_hook: While Chen Ji was still processing the information revealed by the Celestial Envoy, Cang Yutian in the far Northern Region suddenly received a mysterious transmission he had waited a thousand years for—and the content of this transmission made the foremost expert of the current era's face turn ashen in an instant.

text.content: Before Chen Ji could recover from the shock, the deep voice of the Cosmic Eye rang out again—it was about to tell him the secret that the Heavenly Dao's Eye least wished to be known. The Cosmic Eye paused, as if weighing something, before finally speaking slowly: "The Celestial Realm... is not as transcendent as you know. They and the Heavenly Dao's Eye are, in truth, two sides born from the same source."

Before the words even finished, the void around Chen Ji twisted violently. A blazing white light, radiant as the sun, tore through from the depths of the heavens and pierced directly through the secret realm space he occupied. The power contained within that light made Chen Ji's pupils contract sharply—this was a pressure that transcended everything he knew, purer and more ancient than even the projection of the Heavenly Dao's Eye.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." The voice did not come from within the light, but rang directly in the depths of his divine soul,calm得近乎cold, "The Celestial Realm has been watching you for a very long time."

text.content: The light slowly condensed into a humanoid silhouette, yet it was not a true physical form—it was a projection, a phantom woven from countless law runes. The envoy's form was vague and difficult to discern, the only clear features being those eyes that seemed capable of seeing through the very origin of all things, their swirling light making Chen Ji feel that all his secrets were laid bare within them.

dialogue.content: "The Tianji Record in your hands is merely a fragment." The envoy's voice carried not the slightest emotional fluctuation, "The complete Tianji Record has always resided within the Celestial Realm. Every generation of prophets has been a chess piece arranged by the Celestial Realm—including the Heavenly Dao's Eye itself."

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the monstrous waves in his heart, yet his expression remained as calm as ever. He spoke slowly, his voice neither humble nor arrogant: "Since the Celestial Realm has long known of my existence, why wait until today to appear? Do you think this Chen Ji... worthy of the Celestial Realm's personal recruitment?"

The envoy's projection rippled slightly, as if scrutinizing this mere Golden Core stage ant. After several breaths of silence, a barely audible light laugh rang out from the void: "Interesting. Knowing of the Celestial Realm's existence, yet never kneeling; facing the Celestial Realm's pressure, yet never trembling. You are more... unique than any prophet before."

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Dao's Eye wishes to devour your Tianji Record to complete itself." The envoy's tone remained indifferent, "The Celestial Realm can help you destroy its core. But as the price——" The projection stepped forward, the pressure suddenly intensifying, "You must serve the Celestial Realm."

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze, as if seriously contemplating this proposal. However, the fingers hidden in his sleeve had already subtly formed a seal, and the Tianji Record fragment trembled slightly in the depths of his divine soul—he was quietly deducing the consequences of both accepting and refusing. This was his greatest reliance, and also his instinct to never place himself in a desperate situation.

choice.prompt: The Celestial Realm's offer was enticing yet dangerous. Chen Ji had to make a choice under the Celestial Realm's pressure.

choices.description: First agree to the Celestial Realm's conditions to obtain help destroying the Heavenly Dao's Eye's core, while preserving one's trump cards and escape routes.
choices.visible_cost: Need to temporarily obey the Celestial Realm's dispatch
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Celestial Realm's power support for confronting the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through by the Celestial Realm, or lose autonomy under the Celestial Realm's exploitation

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze meeting that of the Celestial Realm's envoy's projection. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly, revealing a meaningful smile: "I appreciate the Celestial Realm's kindness. Since the Heavenly Dao's Eye wants my life, then I and the Celestial Realm are on the same path." The words fell, he shifted his tone, "However—serving the Celestial Realm is acceptable, but this Chen Ji has his own principles in how he conducts affairs."

choices.description: The Celestial Realm and the Heavenly Dao's Eye share the same origin—how do we know it's not another abyss? Chen Ji never entrusts his fate to any force.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Celestial Realm as a potential ally
choices.visible_reward: Maintain independence and autonomy, free from the Celestial Realm's constraints
choices.risk_hint: May anger the Celestial Realm, inviting greater hostility

text.content: Chen Ji let out a light laugh, that laughter sounding especially jarring beneath the majestic pressure. He shook his head, his tone carrying a hint of mockery: "The Celestial Realm, the Heavenly Dao's Eye... you all wish to use Chen Ji as a chess piece. Unfortunately, what this Chen Ji hates most in this life is being manipulated." His gaze suddenly turned cold, "This condition, I do not accept."

choices.description: Neither refusing nor accepting, but attempting to extract more intelligence about the Heavenly Realm and the Eyes of Heavenly Dao from this contact for his own use.
choices.visible_cost: May alert the Heavenly Realm to Chen Ji's calculations
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence to prepare for future confrontation with the Heavenly Realm
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Realm emissary may see through Chen Ji's intentions

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately; instead, he studied the emissary's projection with great interest. He spoke slowly: "Since the Heavenly Realm knows the weakness of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, you must surely know more things I don't. For instance——" He paused, his eyes flashing, "What exists behind Cang Yutian?"

The emissary's projection fell silent for a moment, as if not expecting this Golden Core stage junior to be so composed before him. Chen Ji noticed a flicker within that vague silhouette—was it surprise? Or... interest?

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian?" The emissary's tone finally carried a hint offluctuation, and a meaningful light passed through those all-seeing eyes. "You are quite perceptive. Indeed, he is not the true ultimate chess player—behind him lies the layout of a higher existence." The emissary's voice dropped lower. "This answer requires you to truly cooperate with the Heavenly Realm before you can know it."

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes as the Tianji Record Fragment rapidly operated within his divine soul. He attempted to deduce more information from these words, yet found the imagery concerning the "higher existence" blurred indistinguishably—like the sensation he experienced each time he tried to foresee matters related to his sister Chen Nian. This caused his heart to sink, and generated unprecedented vigilance toward that so-called "higher existence."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Realm emissary dangled bait regarding the higher existence behind Cang Yutian, and Chen Ji must decide his next strategy.

choices.text: Using this as bait, accept cooperation
choices.description: Since a higher existence is manipulating events, confronting the Eyes of Heavenly Dao alone is insufficient. Chen Ji decides to prioritize intelligence acquisition and temporarily cooperate with the Heavenly Realm.
choices.visible_cost: Requires temporarily obeying the Heavenly Realm's dispatch, exposing part of his trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key intelligence regarding the higher existence
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Realm may use this to penetrate Chen Ji's布局

text.content: Chen Ji pondered silently for a moment, then finally nodded: "Very well. But I have three conditions—first, the Heavenly Realm must not interfere with my methods; second, intelligence about the higher existence must be shared without reservation; third—" his gaze sharpened like a blade, "if one day I wish to withdraw, the Heavenly Realm must not obstruct."

choices.description: Although the higher existence is dangerous, the Heavenly Realm's conditions are even less trustworthy. Chen Ji would rather investigate step by step himself than be controlled by others.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the channel to acquire intelligence from the Heavenly Realm
choices.risk_hint: The path to investigating the higher existence will be even more arduous

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, his tone flat yet uncompromising: "I appreciate the Heavenly Realm's kindness, but this Chen prefers to control his own fate. What the higher existence is, I will investigate myself. The Heavenly Realm's cooperation—" he made a gesture of dismissal, "is beyond my reach."

The emissary's projection floated silently within Chen Ji's words, those all-seeing eyes revealing no emotion whatsoever. After a moment of silence, the projection began to dissipate slowly, but the emissary's voice rang out once more, carrying a warning tone Chen Ji could not ignore.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, you are quite special—special enough to make the Heavenly Realm feel a hint of threat." The emissary's voice faded yet remained crystal clear. "But remember, however you choose, the Heavenly Realm will be watching you. The chess game of Heavenly Dao has reached its final juncture, and you—" in the final instant before the projection vanished completely, there was an inexplicable smile in the voice, "are both the variable and the key."

text.content: The secret realm space returned to dead silence. Chen Ji stood alone, his expression unreadable. His fingers gently rubbed the Tianji Record Fragment as his mind rapidly organized all the information just obtained. The Heavenly Realm sharing the same origin as the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, a higher existence behind Cang Yutian, being regarded as "threat" and "key" by the Heavenly Realm... each piece of information was enough to overturn his previous understanding.

"The Heavenly Realm... is more dangerous than the Eyes of Heavenly Dao." Chen Ji murmured to himself, yet his eyes held not a trace of fear—instead, a sharp gleam flickered within. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly. "However, the more interesting the game, the more Chen Ji wishes to personally play it out." He raised his head toward the void, as if to pierce through重重 obstacles and see that so-called "Heavenly Realm." "Since you all treat me as a chess piece, let me show you—who is the true chess player."

choice.prompt: The emissary from the Heavenly Realm has departed, but Chen Ji obtained crucial information. Now he must decide his next move.

choices.description: Since the Heavenly Realm hinted that Cang Yutian has a Higher Existence behind him, Chen Ji will follow this clue, piecing together the trail.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Intelligence on the Higher Existence in Advance
choices.risk_hint: The power of the Higher Existence is unknown, possibly extremely dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, allowing the Tianji Record Fragment to unfold within his soul. Using Cang Yutian as the fulcrum, he began deducing the possible identity of the Higher Existence behind him. The visions from the Tianji Record flickered hazily in the chaos, yet始终 unable to capture the core—that entity's aura was obscured by an even more powerful force. Yet Chen Ji remained undeterred, a faint smile curling at the corner of his lips: 'Where there is concealment, there is existence. Wait and see.'

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng is the guardian of the Tianji Record; perhaps he knows the truth about the Heavenly Realm and the Higher Existence.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consumption of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: May obtain crucial intelligence about the Heavenly Realm
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng only reveals what should be said, bit by bit

text.content: Chen Ji's divine consciousness entered the first page of the Tianji Record, where that frail remnant soul slowly materialized. Mo Xiansheng's form was even more translucent than before, yet his tone remained tranquil: 'Does the master summon this old servant for matters concerning the Heavenly Realm?' Chen Ji nodded, getting straight to the point: 'Do you know that the Heavenly Realm and the Eye of Heavenly Dao share the same origin?' Mo Xiansheng fell into a long silence before speaking slowly: 'This matter... this old servant knows somewhat. But now is not the time for complete revelation.'

Just as Chen Ji was contemplating, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly quivered violently. An ancient line of text surfaced on the paper—a warning left by Mo Xiansheng through the power of his remnant soul: 'Master, be wary of Cang Yutian. He has sensed the contact between the Heavenly Realm and you—the true storm is approaching.' Chen Ji gazed at these words, a sharp cold light flickering in his eyes. He carefully stowed the fragment, raised his head to look toward the distant Northern Territory, and a meaningful curve formed at the corner of his lips: 'Cang Yutian? Do you think cutting off the connection between the Heavenly Realm and me allows you to rest easy?' His voice was soft, yet carried unwavering certainty, 'Very well, then let me see—just who is this 'Higher Existence' behind you.'
